title: Multiple Arm Study of Sebacia Microparticles in the Treatment of Acne Vulgaris
brief_summary: Prospective, multicenter study with multiple arms to examine the safety and effectiveness of the Sebacia Acne Treatment System for the treatment of acne vulgaris.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical diagnosis of moderate to severe acne vulgaris

Exclusion Criteria:

* use of oral retinoid therapy in the past 12 months
* pregnancy, lactating, or planning to become pregnant
* excessive scarring in the treatment area, or other condition that would impact the ability to evaluate acne
